title: InvocationEnvelope
description: The V0 stage invocation envelope: what the runner hands a stage when the workflow advances (ARCHITECTURE.md §5). Carries context POINTERS only — never upstream result bodies (§2.4).

taskId.description: Stage instance identifier within this run.

runId.description: Run identifier, also used as the run's OpenTelemetry trace ID.

triggerRef.description: The event or item that caused the run. Bounded scheduler metadata only, never the provider's raw trigger payload.

branchNamespace.description: The gaggle's run-branch namespace root (GaggleSpec.BranchNamespace); empty means the default 'goobers/'. Injected as GOOBERS_BRANCH_NAMESPACE (#965/#1010).

baseBranch.description: The gaggle's configured default branch (GaggleSpec.Project.Branch/RepoRef.Branch); empty means the default 'main'. Injected as GOOBERS_BASE_BRANCH (#2087).

goober.description: Goober this invocation is for; absent for a deterministic stage or an automated gate. The local runner dispatches from the workflow definition and never needed it on the wire; a Temporal worker has only the envelope, so without it the agentic seam cannot resolve which goober to construct.

goal.description: Intended outcome of this stage, copied from its workflow definition.

instructionAddendum.description: An operator-supplied, one-off addition to the agent instructions for this invocation. Never persisted to the workflow definition.

workspace.description: Absolute path to the fresh, isolated, disposable working copy the stage runs in (§5).

item.description: Bounded provider-neutral descriptor of the backlog item that started the run. Omitted when no item triggered the run.

repoRef.description: Primary repository targeted by this run.

additionalWorkspaces.description: Read-only checkouts of the gaggle's reference repos (GaggleSpec.AdditionalRepos, MGV-11 #1286). The stage may read them; no push credential is provisioned, so they are read-only by construction. Surfaced as GOOBERS_ADDITIONAL_REPO_<UPPER_SANITIZED_NAME>=<path>.

checkoutCones.description: Present only when the runner honored a project.checkout.sparse declaration (#649): repo-relative path cones actually materialized, keyed by workspace identity ('' for the primary workspace, else the matching additionalWorkspaces[i].name). A workspace absent from this object has a full checkout.

contextPointers.description: Read-only inputs: journal artifact pointers and external refs. Pointers only.

minimumIntegrity.description: Lowest input-integrity grade the stage accepts. The runner refuses lower-graded input before dispatch.

capabilities.description: Declared capability grants (e.g. 'github:issues:write'). Undeclared use fails closed (§5).

limits.description: Execution and agent-usage limits applied to this stage.

inputs.description: The stage's static config from its definition. The stage's own config — not another stage's state. Unlike result.schema.json's outputs (scalar-bounded by schema), inputs is intentionally unconstrained: the anti-smuggling invariant here is convention-backed, not schema-enforced, because the runner deliberately routes a gate's subject-stage status/outputs through a gate's own inputs (internal/runner's flattening into env.Inputs before an automated/agentic gate evaluation, internal/gate.InputKeyStatus) — a small, scalar-only, one-directional bridge, not the general reach-through §2.4 forbids (#125).

backlogItem.description: Provider-neutral snapshot descriptor for the item that triggered the run; the content-digested snapshot remains in the journal.

id.description: Provider-native item identifier, such as an issue or work-item number.

labels.description: Provider labels attached to the item.

integrity.description: Provenance grade of the provider-authored title/body.

additionalWorkspace.description: Read-only checkout of one gaggle reference repository supplied alongside the primary workspace.

name.description: Reference repository name from the gaggle definition.

path.description: Absolute path to the read-only checkout.

repoRef.description: Provider-neutral repository identity and credential-connection reference.

baseUrl.description: Forge root URL (e.g. https://gitea.example.com); required when provider is gitea, since self-hosted Gitea has no fixed host.

owner.description: GitHub organization or user, or Azure DevOps organization.

project.description: Azure DevOps project containing the repository.

branch.description: Default branch checked out and targeted by the run.

connectionRef.description: Connection that supplies credentials for the repository.

limits.description: Stage execution limits. Zero values mean no explicit limit.

maxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum stage wall-clock duration in seconds.

maxTokens.description: Maximum model tokens the stage may consume.

maxCostUSD.description: Maximum model spend in US dollars.

contextPointer.description: Exactly one of artifact or external.

name.description: Logical handle the stage uses to refer to this input.

branch.description: Declaration-ordered id of the parallel branch that produced this artifact. Present only on artifacts fanned into a join.

branchName.description: Declared name of the parallel branch that produced this artifact. Paired with branch.

integrity.description: Provenance grade evaluated by stage input admission.

artifact.description: Pointer to a digest-verified artifact in this run or the run named by runId.

external.description: Locator for a resource outside the run journal, such as an issue or pull request.

runId.description: The run whose journal `artifact` lives in, when it is NOT this stage's own run (cross-run evidence resolution, #103/T3). Empty/absent means the artifact is this run's own upstream output. A non-empty value crosses a trust boundary and requires the journal:read capability, enforced by the harness. Mirrors ContextPointer.RunID (Go); present here so a valid cross-run envelope passes this closed schema (#125).

externalRef.description: Content-free locator for a resource outside the run journal.

kind.description: Reference category, such as issue, pull-request, or url.

description.description: Optional human-facing label for the reference.
